about.title: About us
about.personalStory: I lead projects end to end, from the first idea to production. You work directly with the people building your software — without layers of account managers or unnecessary handoffs.
about.teamNote:
I keep the core team small and bring in trusted specialists when a project calls for them.
That means senior-level attention without the overhead of a traditional agency.
about.newChapter:
Based in Córdoba, Argentina, working with teams across the US, Canada, and Europe.
We build custom software and automations for businesses whose operations have outgrown spreadsheets and manual processes.

howWeWork.title: Working methodology
howWeWork.subtitle: A clear process to take your idea from concept to launch.

discovery.title: Discovery
discovery.description:
We align on your business, goals, and users.
We define scope, priorities, and a plan that works for you.

design.title: Design & planning
design.description:
We structure the solution: architecture, flows, and UX.
We validate with you before writing code so there are no surprises.

development.title: Development
development.description:
Iterative build with quality code.
Regular updates and incremental deliveries so you can track progress.

launch.title: Launch & support
launch.description:
Deploy, documentation, and post-launch support.
You get everything you need to maintain or scale the product.

whyChooseUs.title: Why work this way
whyChooseUs.subtitle: Three things you won't get from an agency or a no-code tool.

expertise.title: You talk to whoever builds it
expertise.description: There's no account manager taking notes and translating them later. The person who understands your problem is the one writing the code, so nothing gets lost in between.

delivery.title: The code is yours
delivery.description: Repository, documentation and access in your name from day one. If you want to continue with another team tomorrow, you can: there's no proprietary platform holding you.

collaboration.title: You watch it grow, you don't just wait
collaboration.description: Partial releases you can actually use while it's being built. Anything off-track shows up in week one, while fixing it is still cheap, instead of at final delivery.
